question: Which of the following teams became the runner-up at IPL 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi Capitals**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• IPL 2020 was won by **Mumbai Indians**.

 
 
• It was held in** UAE** due to an increase in Covid-19 cases in India.
 
• It is a **T20 franchise cricket tournament**.
 
 
 
• **​Mumbai Indians** became a **five-time** champion by winning the tournament in 2020.
 
• **Delhi Capitals** first time reached the finals in 2020 in its entire IPL career.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first season of IPL was organised in the year **2008**.
 
• Rajasthan Royals were the inaugural winner of the 1st IPL.
 
• The first match of IPL was played between **Kolkata Knight Riders and Royal Challengers Bangalore**.
